content.test_md_blob:
# Changing the time range clears a locked allocation selection

> Prove a supported time-range change clears an existing locked allocation selection so the card does not keep stale focus after context changes.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.

## Step 2

On the Allocation Card, click the Equities segment so the card enters its focused selection state for that allocation.

## Step 3

In the workspace header time-range segmented control, change the active range from 1M to 3M.

## Step 4

On the Allocation Card, confirm the prior allocation selection is cleared after the time-range change and confirm the legend still shows each allocation entry with an asset class, percentage, and value.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-56, ac-48, ac-49, ac-50

Confirm presence check: each legend entry includes an asset class label (forall) — the stated promise: Each legend entry shows an asset class.
